headline: Manacá-1B-Instruct-2 reports PT-BR safety results and an LLM-judge refusal failure
summary: An October 14 arXiv report describes Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, a 1.72B-parameter model trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese, with a new safety-SFT alignment and unusually detailed negative results. The authors report 97.2% held-out safety on 218 harmful prompts against four external PT-BR models tested on the same items and harness; the lower Wilson confidence bound is 94.1%, above all four baselines. The paper also reports that its Claude judge refused to score 2 of 6 sensitive MT-Bench-PT prompts regardless of the evaluated answer, reducing the effective sample for this category across eight historical project reports. The authors say their repository now exposes this missingness. These are author-reported results; model scale, benchmark scope, low absolute general capability and absent independent reproduction sharply limit wider claims.
